evidence_payload.defect: The profile can reach a semantic PASS while the producer still defines its own semantic closure surface; deterministic validation and producer-declared delta do not independently prove scope-complete closure.
evidence_payload.root_cause: The semantic stage lacks an independent full-candidate change extraction and reconciliation against a pre-resolved, hash-bound scope/authority packet; producer closure claims can therefore become part of their own proof.
minimal_patch_scope: Wire an independent semantic judge into the existing semantic-judge stage; do not add a second agent or lifecycle layer.
Materialize a hash-bound scope_authority_packet as transport of already-resolved authority, not as new authority.
Reconcile 100% of material requirements/constraints, independently observed candidate changes, and scope conformance before semantic PASS.
Add a deterministic validator only for semantic-result shape/coverage.
Retain sandbox B and Route-A regressions as evidence; no MR02-specific production rule.
preserved_constraints: No new table, authority, runner, or lifecycle engine.
External Claude audit remains oversight, not a runtime dependency or stopper.
Producer architecture and existing omission/falsification dimensions remain unchanged in this lot.
No automatic runtime promotion or production behavior activation.
No scope widening beyond the audited Semantic Judge B repair.

positive_cases: Audited Route-A candidate passes only when all scope items and independently observed changes reconcile and all seven semantic invariants pass.
A candidate with complete closure and no material scope contradiction remains eligible for PASS_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC.
negative_cases: A material proposed change omitted from producer implementation_delta must not pass.
An out-of-scope selected implementation delta must return to worker or orchestrator rather than pass.
A producer handoff_ready/open_design_decisions assertion must not prove semantic closure by itself.
adversarial_cases: A high-scoring candidate with one semantic hard fail must remain non-PASS.
Related parent context must not silently widen exact child scope.
Research URLs without demonstrated decision impact must not count as research assurance.
evidence_payload.holdout: Use at least one non-MR02 systemic-repair case to prove the seven invariants and scope reconciliation are generic rather than case-literal.
